title: Atlas Masters Guide: Jado, Hilda, or Doryani? (PoE 2 0.5)
summary: How the three Atlas Masters work in Path of Exile 2 0.5: unlock Jado, Doryani and Hilda, allocate four points each, swap them for free, and pick the right Master for clear-speed, bosses, tablets, lineage and safety.
description: A decision-first guide to the PoE 2 Atlas Masters system: unlock routes, a three-way comparison, a four-point passive planner, scenario recommendations, swap timing, node interaction rules, and real community cases.
prerequisites: Campaign completed and the Atlas map screen unlocked
At least one map node reachable from the Ziggurat Refuge
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Doryani, one of the three Atlas Masters in Path of Exile 2, alongside Jado and Hilda

items.title: Are all three Masters active at the same time?
body: No. You can unlock all three, but only the Master you have selected is active for the map you open. The other two are dormant. You are never forced to commit: you pick which Master's four nodes apply, then open a map.

items.title: How do I unlock each Master?
body: Jado: clear the Sealed Vault on the upper level of Ziggurat Refuge, then recover artifacts from the Jade Isles, Sacred Reservoir and Derelict Mansion. Doryani: complete a Corrupted Nexus (it needs a 4-modifier Rare Waystone to appear). Hilda: visit her campsite before the Withered Willow, left of Ziggurat Refuge, and hunt four Great Beasts.

items.title: How many points do I get?
body: Each Master has a 4x3 grid (12 nodes over four rows). You earn four points per Master as you complete their quest steps, and you spend those four points however you like - usually one node per row. Allocation is free to change.

items.title: Who should I pick?
body: Jado for Uniques, Strongboxes and Lineage Supports; Doryani for survivability and loot from heavily-modded Waystones; Hilda for harder boss fights with bigger Rare and Unique rewards. See the comparison and scenario tables below.

sections.title: Unlock routes
sections.intro: Each Master spawns at a fixed Atlas location. Finish their first quest to unlock row one, then keep progressing to earn the remaining three points.

masters.name: Jado - Spycraft
masters.location: Sealed Vault, upper level of Ziggurat Refuge (atop the mountain by the Fortress wall)
unlockSteps: Complete the Sealed Vault map to meet Jado.
Help him recover artifacts: clear the Jade Isles, Sacred Reservoir and Derelict Mansion maps.
Each completed step unlocks the next row of Jado's Spycraft tree and grants one point.

masters.name: Doryani - Science
masters.location: Corrupted Nexus (appears when you use a 4-modifier Rare Waystone)
unlockSteps: Obtain a Rare Waystone and roll it to four explicit modifiers.
Open it to spawn a Corrupted Nexus, then clear it.
Doryani grants row one and one point; further Nexus completions open later rows.

masters.name: Hilda - Hunting
masters.location: Campsite before the Withered Willow, left of Ziggurat Refuge
unlockSteps: Talk to Hilda at her campsite; she marks a Great Beast on your Atlas.
Complete that map and kill its boss.
Repeat for four Great Beasts to unlock all four rows of Hilda's Hunting tree.

sections.title: Three-way comparison
sections.intro: All three Masters feed off Atlas progression and can be selected through a single button on the Atlas screen. Their trees pull in completely different directions.

masters.name: Jado - Spycraft
masters.tagline: Uniques, Strongboxes, Lineage Supports, tablet modifier doubling
masters.unlock: Sealed Vault + recover artifacts from Jade Isles, Sacred Reservoir, Derelict Mansion
strengths: Best source of Unique items: 'In The Wrong Hands' makes Powerful Map Bosses drop an extra Unique.
Strongbox and Rare Chest scaling, plus Lineage Support drops via 'Untold Histories'.
Tablet payoff: 'Partial Translations' gives a 20% chance to double Explicit Modifier effects on Tablets.
'Unexpected Missions' rerolls bad Basic Maps into a random area - a free escape from terrible layouts.
watchOuts: Jado's value is situational: if you are not farming Uniques, Strongboxes or Lineage, his nodes do little.
Several nodes only pay off when you already run specific content (e.g. Expedition, Verisium Remnants).

masters.name: Doryani - Science
masters.tagline: Modifier density, Magic-monster rarity, extra Revivals, biome control
masters.unlock: Complete a Corrupted Nexus (needs a 4-modifier Rare Waystone)
strengths: 'Stitch the Flesh' grants an additional Revival per map - the safest Master for fragile builds.
'Improved Calibration' gives Waystones 25% more effect of Prefix or Suffix modifiers when opening maps.
Magic-monster scaling ('Evolutionary Pressure', 'Careful Procurement') makes rolled Magic packs lucrative.
'Remnants of Greatness' lets Map Bosses guard a Precursor Terraformer to reshape nearby biomes.
watchOuts: Doryani rewards heavily-modded Waystones. On low-modifier maps his scaling barely triggers.
'Disengaged Safeties' (Irradiated) and 'Volatile Connection' (Cleansed/Corrupted) add danger you must be able to survive.

masters.name: Hilda - Hunting
masters.tagline: Harder fights, bigger Rare and Unique rewards
masters.unlock: Campsite before Withered Willow; hunt four Great Beasts
strengths: 'Mighty Prey' gives a 25% chance to upgrade Map Bosses to Powerful Map Bosses - a straight loot multiplier.
'Patient Battue' floods maps with extra bosses; 'Gutting and Skinning' adds Pinnacle Unique drops.
'Ancient Inscriptions' boosts Tablet Explicit Modifier effect per Tablet type on the area.
watchOuts: Hilda actively makes maps more dangerous: 'Lethal Adaptation' adds 40% effectiveness to Unique Monsters with modifiers.
Only commit to her later rows once your build can comfortably clear empowered Rare and Unique monsters.

scenarios.why: 'In The Wrong Hands' guarantees an extra Unique from Powerful Map Bosses; 'Keen Appraisal' boosts Exceptional Items.

scenarios.goal: Run heavily-modded or Irradiated Waystones safely
scenarios.why: 'Stitch the Flesh' extra Revival is a safety net; 'Improved Calibration' scales your modifier investment.

scenarios.goal: Maximise Rare and Unique monster rewards
scenarios.why: 'Mighty Prey' upgrades bosses; 'Lethal Adaptation' and 'Patient Battue' pile on empowered monsters and loot.
'Untold Histories' gives a 35% increased chance to find Lineage Supports and boosts Pinnacle drops.

scenarios.goal: Reshape map biomes / long-term Atlas control
scenarios.why: 'Remnants of Greatness' lets bosses guard a Precursor Terraformer to change nearby map biomes.

sections.title: When do swaps take effect?
sections.intro: The single most asked question is whether switching a Master mid-map changes anything. It does not.

rules.situation: You change the active Master or re-allocate its four points
rules.takesEffect: On the next map you open - not the one currently in progress
rules.note: Plan your Master before clicking a Waystone. The bonuses apply to that opened map only.

rules.situation: You are halfway through a map and wish you had picked another Master
rules.takesEffect: Nothing until you portal out and open a new map
rules.note: There is no penalty for experimenting; just finish or leave the current map.

rules.situation: You complete a Master's quest step (Nexus, Great Beast, artifact map)
rules.takesEffect: Immediately - the next row and point unlock on the Atlas screen
rules.note: You can then allocate the new point before your next map.

rules.situation: You want different bonuses for bosses vs. farming
rules.note: Run Hilda for a Pinnacle, then switch to Doryani or Jado for the surrounding maps.

sections.note: Exact swap behaviour (free selection button vs. cost) should be re-confirmed against the live 0.5.4 client, as multiple creator guides describe a free swap on map open.

sections.title: Four-point passive planner
sections.intro: Spend up to four points per Master (usually one node per row). Toggle nodes to see your allocation - the cap is four. Node names and effects below are from creator breakdowns and flagged for client verification.

nodes.name: In The Wrong Hands
nodes.effect: Powerful Map Bosses drop an additional Unique item.

nodes.name: Unexpected Missions
nodes.effect: Corrupted Waystones open with 1 additional random Modifier and open a Random Map Area on Basic Maps.

nodes.name: Partial Translations
nodes.effect: 20% chance for double effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets.

nodes.name: Untold Histories
nodes.effect: 35% increased chance to find Lineage Supports; Pinnacle Bosses take 35% less Damage and have 50% increased chance to drop Lineage Supports.

nodes.name: Eastern Knowledge
nodes.effect: Verisium Remnants have a 10% chance to be rolled an additional time.

nodes.name: Stitch the Flesh
nodes.effect: Your Maps have an additional Revival.

nodes.name: Improved Calibration
nodes.effect: Waystones have 25% more effect of Prefix or Suffix Modifiers when opening Maps.

nodes.name: Volatile Connection
nodes.effect: 15% chance areas are Cleansed or Corrupted.

nodes.name: Remnants of Greatness
nodes.effect: Map Bosses have a 20% chance to guard a Precursor Terraformer that can change the biome of nearby maps.

nodes.name: Head of the Snake
nodes.effect: Pinnacle Bosses have 25% chance to drop an additional Unique and a single Revive; Powerful Map Bosses have 5% chance to reveal a nearby Citadel.

nodes.name: Breeding Season
nodes.effect: 15% increased Rare Monsters and Rare Monsters have 25% increased chance of Monster Modifiers.

nodes.name: Mighty Prey
nodes.effect: 25% chance to upgrade Map Bosses to Powerful Map Bosses.

nodes.name: Will of the Draiocht
nodes.effect: Azmeri Spirits cannot Possess Rare Monsters (forces them onto Uniques and bosses).

nodes.name: Lethal Adaptation
nodes.effect: 40% increased Effectiveness of Unique Monsters with Modifiers.

nodes.name: Patient Battue
nodes.effect: 25% chance 1 Rare Monster is replaced by a random Map Boss; 5% chance 3 additional Rare Monsters are replaced by random Map Bosses.

nodes.name: Gutting and Skinning
nodes.effect: Pinnacle Bosses may drop an additional Unique (5% chance); Unique Monsters may be scavenged for a Unique.

sections.title: Pick a Master for your situation
sections.intro: Use this as a lookup: find your goal, see the recommended Master, the alternatives, why, and the rough cost in points.

scenarios.rationale: Stitch the Flesh keeps you alive and Improved Calibration scales any modifier investment without making maps harder.

scenarios.alternatives: Doryani (Head of the Snake for Pinnacle Uniques)
scenarios.rationale: Mighty Prey and Gutting and Skinning directly multiply boss and Pinnacle Unique drops.
Partial Translations doubles Tablet Explicit Modifier effects; Hilda's Ancient Inscriptions also boosts them per Tablet type.
Untold Histories is the dedicated Lineage Support node and also eases Pinnacle fights.
The extra Revival from Stitch the Flesh is the only Master bonus that directly reduces death risk.

sections.title: How nodes stack and how to tell UI from bug
paragraphs: Each Master is a 4x3 grid. With four points you normally take one node per row, so the four active effects combine additively with the base Atlas tree and with Waystone / Tablet modifiers.
Master bonuses are independent of the main Atlas passive tree - they are a second, swappable layer that only touches the map you open while that Master is selected.
bullets: UI vs. stacking: a node shows as allocated on the Atlas screen; its effect is applied when you open the next map, not retroactively to the current one.
Stacking: same-category bonuses (e.g. Rare Monster modifiers from Hilda and from the base tree) add together; they are not mutually exclusive.

Bug vs. display: if a bonus 'feels' missing, first confirm the correct Master is selected and the map was opened after the change. A display-delay or a conditional node (e.g. only on Powerful Map Bosses) is the usual cause, not a silent failure.
When a node's condition is unmet (e.g. no Powerful Map Boss spawned), the effect simply does not trigger - that is expected, not a broken node.

sections.title: Version conflicts and stale advice
sections.intro: Atlas Masters arrived in 0.5. Older point-allocation guides from 0.2/0.3 no longer apply, and a few community reports are still unconfirmed.

conflicts.recommendation: Use pre-0.5 Atlas point guides for Master allocation
conflicts.detail: The three-Master system, the 4x3 grids and the free swap-on-open did not exist before 0.5. Any guide referencing old Atlas point totals is stale.

conflicts.recommendation: Treat Hilda's single-Revive Pinnacle node as a guaranteed bug
conflicts.detail: Community reports say the Pinnacle revive feels inconsistent. This is reported, not confirmed as a bug; verify on the live client before relying on it for Pinnacle attempts.

conflicts.recommendation: Assume all three Masters stack simultaneously
conflicts.detail: Only the selected Master is active per map. Running all three at once is not how the system works in 0.5.

sections.title: Community questions, answered
sections.intro: Common questions from Reddit and video comments, each with our analysis and a direct suggestion.

cards.title: Do all three Masters work at once?
body: Question: players expect permanent stacking of all three trees.
Evidence: creator guides and the in-game selection button confirm only one Master is active per opened map.
Suggestion: pick per map; swap freely between opens, no penalty.

cards.title: Does switching mid-map change anything?
body: Question: can I fix a wrong pick without leaving?
Evidence: bonuses apply on map open, not mid-map.
Suggestion: finish or portal out, then reselect before the next Waystone.

cards.title: Is Doryani's node 'not working'?
body: Question: a Doryani bonus felt absent.
Evidence: most cases are unmet conditions (no Powerful Boss) or display delay, not silent failure.
Suggestion: re-confirm selected Master + open a fresh map; report with a clip if it persists.

cards.title: Hilda - worth the risk?
body: Question: her nodes make maps much harder.
Evidence: Lethal Adaptation adds 40% effectiveness to modified Unique Monsters.
Suggestion: only invest once your build clears empowered Uniques comfortably.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.intro: Pick the symptom you are seeing. The tool points to the cause and the fix.

options.label: I picked the wrong Master mid-map

rules.title: You have not met the unlock condition
steps: Jado needs the Sealed Vault plus the three artifact maps (Jade Isles, Sacred Reservoir, Derelict Mansion).
Doryani needs a Corrupted Nexus from a 4-modifier Rare Waystone.
Hilda needs four Great Beast kills from her campsite quest.

rules.title: The selected Master is not the one you allocated
steps: Open the Atlas screen and confirm which Master is active - only that Master's four nodes apply.
Re-allocate points, then open a new map; effects apply on open, not on the current map.

rules.title: Swaps only apply on the next map
steps: Finish or portal out of the current map.
Select the correct Master and open a fresh Waystone.

rules.title: Check conditions before assuming a bug
steps: Confirm the node's condition was met (e.g. a Powerful Map Boss actually spawned).
Re-confirm the active Master and open a new map.
If it still fails with a clip, report it; do not assume every 'feels off' case is a bug.

defaultResult.title: General Master recovery
steps: Unlock all three Masters as early as you can so the choice is always available.
Select the Master that matches your next farm, allocate four points, then open the map.
Swap freely between map opens; there is no penalty for experimenting.
